Title: vector DB.DBA.VECTOR_OF_NONNULLS_AGG (
Description:
DB.DBA.VECTOR_OF_NONNULLS_AGG returns a vector of passed values.
    Similar to DB.DBA.VECTOR_AGG() but ignores NULL arguments.
DB.DBA.VECTOR_OF_NONNULLS_AGG
DB.DBA.VECTOR_AGG()
The order of items in the vector repeats the order of passing individual values to the aggregate.
